diagnosis.overview: The agent's Python sandbox lacks the openpyxl library, causing all Excel read attempts to fail with ImportError; the agent then guesses spreadsheet contents instead of extracting real values, leading to hallucinated data across tasks.
diagnosis.root_cause: The agent's Python sandbox lacks the openpyxl library, causing all Excel read attempts to fail with ImportError; the agent then guesses spreadsheet contents instead of extracting real values, leading to hallucinated data across tasks.
diagnosis.general_mechanism: 1. Install openpyxl in the Python execution environment and wire in a dedicated `read_excel` tool that reliably returns sheet names and cell values as plain text, so the agent never has to rely on failed code. 2. Amend the agent prompt with a critical rule: 'Before any data transformation, you must successfully inspect the input file using the spreadsheet tool and print at least 5 rows of data; if the read fails, you must report the error and stop rather than guess.'
